description: Label mapping for the structure stage (specs/04-analysis-pipeline.md section 5.2): model vocabulary -> SectionKind. The vocabulary is All-In-One's (start, end, intro, outro, break, bridge, inst, solo, verse, chorus); the weight-free labeller in bragi_analysis.structure.labels emits the same words, so a neural segmenter can replace it without touching this file. The packages/schemas/analysis/taxonomy.json named by 04 is the *tag* taxonomy (WP-1.6); this mapping lives next to the worker until that file exists (Q46).
